visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of coconuts marked with the number '13' and green rectangular perfume boxes labeled 'ALTO ASTRAL' by BYREDO on a bright yellow retail table. (2) The perspective shifts to a wide shot of a bustling, modern airport terminal with high ceilings and steel structures, followed by a shot inside a glass-walled jet bridge. (3) A group of traditional Thai dancers in ornate pink and gold costumes perform a cultural dance in the middle of the airport concourse. (4) A directory map of the airport is shown, followed by the entrance to a 'Butterbear' themed store inside a King Power duty-free area. (5) The camera focuses on the BYREDO perfume counter, showing a white card with the brand name and shelves filled with neatly arranged white perfume boxes. (6) Close-up shots display various BYREDO perfume bottles like 'LA TULIPE' and 'BLANCHE' on yellow pedestals. (7) A person's hand holds the green 'ALTO ASTRAL' juice-box-style perfume packaging in front of a smiling male store assistant. (8) The vlogger is briefly shown inside an airplane cabin wearing a blue denim shirt, holding a scent strip. (9) The video concludes with the vlogger waving goodbye to the friendly male assistant at the bright yellow and green decorated counter.

A subtle 'bubble pop' SFX emphasizes the product reveal. (2) As the scene transitions to the airport terminal, the ambient floor shifts to a mild indoor public space murmur with a slight increase in reverb. (3) The voiceover becomes more rhythmic and melodic during the dancing and shopping segments, maintaining high arousal. (4) A soft whoosh SFX marks the transition from the duty-free shop to the aircraft cabin. (5) In the final phase, the vocal delivery becomes more intimate and appreciative as the vlogger interacts with the store staff, ending with a warm 'bye-bye' and the BGM fading out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Experience -> Product Detail -> Purchase -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle vlog aimed at promoting a limited-edition BYREDO perfume, 'ALTO ASTRAL', available at Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi Airport. It uses a travel narrative to create excitement around the shopping experience and the product's unique coconut scent and packaging.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The vlogger provides a detailed review of the scent, price, and availability of the BYREDO perfume and explicitly encourages purchasing it.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes the vibrant aesthetic of the airport's pop-up shop to create a visually engaging product showcase.
